title: Ben Horowitz: What Founders Must Know About AI and Crypto

reader_summary.headline: Today, we're doing something a little different.
reader_summary.overview: Today, we're doing something a little different. We're dropping an episode from Impact Theory, a show hosted by Tom Villu, featuring a conversation with Ben Horowitz, co-founder of Andreessen Horowitz. Ben rarely does interviews like this, and in this one, he goes deep, on AI, on power, on the future of work.

thesis: Ben Horowitz argues that AI is a sophisticated model of human knowledge rather than a conscious entity or a replacement for human life, emphasizing that humans remain the masters while AI serves as a tool. He suggests that while AI will disrupt many jobs, history shows that humans will adapt to new roles, though he worries about those without alternative skills who may have no refuge if their current capabilities are surpassed by machines.
